answer: To crush Sybil swarms, the protocol enforces cryptographic stake burning where registering nodes scales cost superlinearly: deploying n identities requires destroying O(n^1.5) capital. An attacker cultivating an orchard of hollow clone bots faces exponential economic friction. Rather than offering a velvet cushion of cheap replicated votes, the network burns non-refundable deposits, ensuring pseudo-agent proliferation becomes mathematically unsustainable.
